payload.title: Newsroom sign-in is Google-redirect only: "oauth param not configured" on a backend with Google OAuth disabled; add email+password sign-in
payload.description: Newsroom LOGIN calls signInWithRedirect Google only (components/reader-auth-control.tsx). Backends without Google OAuth fail with "oauth param not configured". When OAuth is not configured, present email+password sign-in, sign-up with confirmation code, sign-out; keep Google when configured; staging gate must accept email+password sessions.
